blocks.heading: A toolkit for turning code, changes, and technical ideas into visual documents.

rows.value: Choose the product-shaped domain for the document you need.
Every product reuses the rendering core and diagram pipeline.

primer.p: The safe HTML, markdown, examples, and shared visual primitives.
Recap explains changes, Atlas maps codebases, and Authoring renders proposals and plans.
Mechanical extraction grounds the visual story in current source.

tiles.name: Rendering core
tiles.purpose: Turns typed visual blocks into safe, self-contained HTML.

tiles.name: Diagram pipeline
tiles.purpose: Compiles authored diagrams and optional editable sidecars.

tiles.name: Code intelligence
tiles.purpose: Extracts code structure, imports, APIs, and data models for visual documents.

tiles.name: Recap
tiles.purpose: Turns a code change into a visual review narrative.

tiles.name: Atlas
tiles.purpose: Builds and maintains the codebase’s standing architecture map.

tiles.name: Authoring
tiles.purpose: Renders proposals, plans, quizzes, and other authored visual documents.
